subject: Additional assertions for listpack (#2027)
reason: Defensive hardening of listpack internals: it adds assertions that an LP_EOF byte lies at the end of the allocation, makes lpValidateNext reject a mid-listpack LP_EOF, and makes lpGetWithSize panic on an invalid encoding byte instead of returning a sentinel integer. On every valid listpack all these paths are unchanged, so no normal command reply, replication stream, or RDB/AOF round-trip of Valkey-produced data differs between the two builds.
